Build & Export

Create supported packages from the current project. Wrappers stay wrappers, and unsafe conversions are blocked instead of guessed.

Target Output Project Name:
(Updates all generated configs, package manifests, and download filenames)
Single HTML Local Assets Inlined
Multi-File / ZIP → Standalone Single HTML
Inlines local stylesheets, scripts, and assets into one HTML file. Existing remote URLs remain external and are reported by the audit.
Output: index.html (Inlined CSS/JS)
Modular Web Standard ZIP
Single HTML → Multi-File Clean ZIP
Extracts plain inline CSS and classic JavaScript into css/style.css and js/app.js. Module/data scripts and special media/nonce blocks stay inline so their behavior is not silently changed.
Output: index.html, css/style.css, js/app.js
React 18 Vite 5
Existing React/Vite Project → Re-export ZIP
Copies an already-verified React/Vite project unchanged. It does not invent React components from HTML, wrap pages in a fake iframe app, or pretend raw TSX is a finished build.
Output: original Vite files only, when the project already is Vite
React Standalone Compiled Build Required
Compiled React / Vite → Single Standalone HTML
Requires an existing compiled React/Vite build such as dist/index.html, build/index.html, or out/index.html. Raw JSX/TSX is not falsely converted into a finished standalone browser build.
Output: app-standalone.html (compiled assets inlined)
Desktop Electron 26
Any Web Project → Electron Wrapper ZIP
Creates a minimal Electron desktop wrapper that opens the current web project. It does not invent preload APIs, IPC routes, or application behavior.
Output: main.js, package.json, existing web files
Web Clean Sandbox Safe
Electron App → Browser Web (Only When Compatible)
Exports browser-ready files only when the renderer has no unresolved Electron/preload dependencies. DEBOOGER refuses the conversion instead of fabricating browser shims.
Output: browser files only after compatibility verification
Backend Express Wrapper
Any Web Project → Static Express Wrapper ZIP
Creates a minimal Express static-file wrapper around the current web project. It does not invent REST APIs, secrets, CORS behavior, or backend business logic.
Output: server.js, package.json, public/

Build B053 is a standalone browser HTML app. It can preview HTML and React/Vite source in the browser, including public/ files, vite aliases, and common Vite imports. It still cannot run a real Vite server, npm install, or Electron main. Those actions need a separate desktop runtime that is not included in this build.
